Well at Work udspringer af 20 års neurov: Well at Work grew out of 20 years of neuroscience research at Aarhus University and University College London. Our co-founder, Professor Kim Mouridsen, has dedicated his career to understanding how the brain works under pressure — and how early cognitive changes can be detected before they become clinical problems.
Det samme team har tidligere bygget Cerc: The same team previously built Cercare Medical — an FDA-approved medical AI platform for brain imaging — and Mindway AI, which is now used by more than 13 million people. Well at Work applies the same scientific rigour and technological approach to a different challenge: understanding and improving organisational wellbeing in ways that make a difference.
Vores ambition er at gøre det lettere at: Our ambition is to make it easier to work on wellbeing every day. That's why we connect insights with personal programmes, leadership coaching and follow-up. Employees, leaders and HR all play an active role in development.

Et spørgeskema giver medarbejderen mulig: A questionnaire gives employees a way to describe their everyday experience. But it can be difficult to put all the patterns that shape it into words.
Derfor kombinerer Atlas Individual spørg: That’s why Atlas Individual combines questions with short, carefully designed game-based activities. The choices and responses along the way add another perspective on how we approach change, interpret impressions and associate words with ourselves.
Små opgaver undersøger, hvordan vi tilpa: Short activities explore how we adapt when something changes and a new approach is needed.
Hvordan læser vi situationen?: How do we read a situation?
Vores første indtryk kan have forskellig: First impressions can take on different shades. These activities explore how we perceive positive and negative signals.
Hvilke ord forbinder vi med os selv?: Which words do we associate with ourselves?
Hurtige valg kan give anledning til refl: Quick choices can prompt reflection on patterns that may not come through when we answer a question.
Spilopgaverne og medarbejderens egne sva: The game-based activities and employees’ own answers are considered together. This gives us more to draw on when choosing relevant exercises and tailoring the personal programme—turning assessment into a starting point for action.
